Who I am

A designer who also teaches, plays guitar and loves making things by hand.

I'm a creative, driven accessories designer with four years' experience in the corporate fashion industry, currently pursuing an MA in Design for Industry 5.0 at Central Saint Martins, University of the Arts London. Alongside this, I've spent six years tutoring children and running summer camps in music, guitar, painting, and craft. I play guitar, love hands-on creative activities, and believe learning works best when playful and engaging. Patient, adaptable, and reliable.
